method: Exact triangle barycentric depth at every effective alpha pixel center (alpha>=128); original facing source mesh faces, not projected bounding boxes. Back label local X includes itsY180-degree rotation.

results.label: front-paper
results.interpretation: Distance is from label plane to the first source CAD face in the inward normal direction at each actual alpha pixel center. A0.2mm recess can be occupied by paper/adhesive; this does not prove physical paper stock thickness or justify lowering the whole image. Current label is a zero-thickness face, with no explicit sheet volume.
